name: capture-scheduler
description: Callsheet: schedule a videographer to capture a company's sales team

scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.postinstall: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm rebuild sqlite3 --prefix backend
scripts.build: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run start --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend"
